response.query: How will participatory mapping be operationalized to ensure inclusive sampling (gender, age, occupation, informal-status), informed consent, compensation, and conflict-mitigation?
response.answer: Participatory mapping ensures inclusive sampling through diverse outreach, informed consent via clear communication, and conflict-mitigation through community dialogue and negotiation.

results.title: The Ohio Department of Medicaid Population Health and ...
results.content: The Ohio Department of Medicaid (ODM) Population Health and Quality Strategy 2026-2028 provides a comprehensive roadmap for ODM and its Medicaid managed care entities (MCEs) to align strategies related to quality of care and services, data driven outcomes measurement, quality improvement, population health management with population-specific goals, and addressing individual member needs to ensure all Medicaid beneficiaries experience appropriate, timely, and positive healthcare and services.
